By Giovanna Bellotti Azevedo and Leda AlvimNovember 16, 2026 at 5:41 PM UTCBookmark

Brazilian assets slumped across the board as traders continue to search for a floor while fretting over the outlook for the nation’s finances under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
The real was the worst performer in emerging-markets Monday, falling more than 2% to the weakest level since April 2025. Swap rates surged, while dollar bonds of highly indebted companies sank in New York trading as investors readjust to the odds of higher-for-longer interest rates.

item.title: Lilly Pushes Buying Spree Beyond $32B With Calytrix Deal
item.description:
Nov 16th, 2026
Lilly Pushes Buying Spree Beyond $32B With Calytrix Deal
Eli Lilly & Co. agreed to buy closely held Calytrix Bio Inc. in a deal that could be worth up to $1.5 billion, the latest in the drugmaker’s $32 billion wave of acquisitions in 2026 as it builds out its cancer and immunology businesses. Sam Fazeli, Bloomberg Intelligence, Director of Research for Global Industries and Senior Pharmaceuticals Analyst, discusses the biotech sector, how AI is playing a role in new developments and the importance of M&A through deals like that of Eli Lilly and Calytrix Bio.

European stocks reversed gains to trade lower as lingering concerns over the artificial-intelligence trade spurred declines in technology shares.
The Stoxx Europe 600 Index was down 0.3% by the close, reversing equivalent gains, dragged down by weakness on Wall Street. Luxury and health stocks outperformed, while mining shares slumped. Utility stocks also trailed and the technology subindex lost about 1.2%, with semiconductors being hit on both sides of the Atlantic.

Canadian Natural Resources agreed to acquire Advantage Energy Ltd. for C$2.255 billion ($1.6 billion), adding to a string of deals in the country’s oil and gas industry as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine boost demand for alternative supplies.
The Canadian driller plans to buy its smaller rival for C$13.55 a share in a deal that will expand its oil and gas production in Alberta, the company said in a statementBloomberg Terminal
on Monday. That’s a 25% premium over Advantage Energy’s closing price on Friday. The overall transaction value is about C$2.53 billion, including Advantage’s net debt and outstanding convertible debentures.

item.description:

Athleisure Faces Price Pressures
Regis Schultz, CEO of JD Sports, discusses the state of sports fashion amid the popularity of running. He says the US is "the most resilient customer" and that JD stores haven't felt much tariff impact because the brands they carry are taking most of the hit. Schultz gives his expectations for the holiday season and which brands will interest the sports fashion consumer. He joins Paul Sweeney and Avalon Pernell on Bloomberg Intelligence.

A selloff in technology stocks carried into a new week as Wall Street traders geared up for Nvidia Corp.’s high-stakes earnings and Anthropic PBC’s expected market debut in the coming days.

US retail diesel prices dropped below $6 a gallon for the first time since early September, taking some pressure off a key inflationary input that has pushed the price of energy and food higher this fall.
Retail diesel prices dropped to $5.9989 a gallon on Monday, according to AAA, down from a peak over $6.50 a gallon in late September.

Takeaways by Bloomberg AI
US stocks extended their slump on Monday, led by technology shares, as investors remained skittish around the AI trade before Nvidia Corp. earnings and the expected initial public offering of Anthropic PBC this week.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index slid 1.8% at 11:52 a.m. in New York, putting the gauge on track for a third-straight losing session. Meanwhile, the broader S&P 500 Index dropped 1.2%, also heading for a third consecutive daily decline.
